_meta.notes: Lexicon of AI-accent tells for scripts/tells.py. Original wording. Severity 1 = mild (fine alone), 2 = common tell, 3 = loud tell. Every entry has why and fix. Words are single tokens; phrases match on word starts; structures are regexes on lowercased text (cs = case-sensitive, raw = unmasked text with markup, min = only count if at least N hits, free = first N hits are not counted, max_words = only in pieces this short, hit = named group that marks the reported span). skip = regex tested near a word hit to drop literal uses; initial/comma = only at a sentence start / only before a comma. Punctuation: one instance is always free except for em dashes; beyond that free_per100 sets the allowance. Tune the numbers here, not in code.
